actionConfiguration.body:
WITH created AS (
  SELECT public.mp_sterilizer_start_run(
    p_planned_item_id => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue)) ? Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL" }}::bigint,
    p_planned_recipe_id => {{ String((qItems.data || []).find(i => String(i.nocopk) === String(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue))?.component_mode || "single_recipe").trim().toLowerCase() === "multi_recipe" ? "NULL" : (Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue)) ? Number(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL") }}::bigint,
    p_planned_count => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedCount.text)) ? Number(inpPlannedCount.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_planned_unit_size => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text)) ? Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_process_type => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(selProcessType.selectedOptionValue) }}::text,
    p_start_time => {{ dpStartTime.selectedDate ? "'" + moment(dpStartTime.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") + "'::timestamp" : "NULL::timestamp" }},
    p_operator => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(SterilizerIn.currentOperator()) }}::text,
    p_target_temp_c => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(txtTargetTemp.text)) ? Number(txtTargetTemp.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_pressure_mode => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(txtPressureMode.text) }}::text,
    p_notes => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(inpRunNotes.text) }}::text,
    p_planned_component_set => {{ String((qItems.data || []).find(i => String(i.nocopk) === String(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue))?.component_mode || "single_recipe").trim().toLowerCase() === "multi_recipe" ? SterilizerIn.sql.str(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL" }}::text
  ) AS nocopk
)

  JOIN public.recipes r

    irc.component_set AS option_value,

      CASE

WITH lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,

    i.default_unit_size_g  AS item_default_unit_size_g,
    i.default_unit_size_oz AS item_default_unit_size_oz,
    i.default_unit_size_lb AS item_default_unit_size_lb,

    CASE
      WHEN l.harvest_weight_g IS NOT NULL AND l.harvest_weight_g::numeric > 0
        THEN l.harvest_weight_g::numeric
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.item_category_mat), ''), NULLIF(btrim(i.category), ''), ''))
           IN ('all_in_one_bag', 'casing', 'fruiting_block', 'grain', 'substrate')
           AND l.unit_size IS NOT NULL
           AND l.unit_size::numeric > 0
        THEN round((l.unit_size::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_g IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_g::numeric > 0
        THEN i.default_unit_size_g::numeric
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_oz IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric * 28.349523125)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS packageable_weight_g

  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON (
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
          THEN l.item_id::bigint
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) = i.nocopk
    OR (
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') <> ''
      AND i.item_id = l.item_id::text
    )
)

SELECT *
FROM lot_rows
WHERE 1=1
  AND (
    {{ inpLotType.selectedOptionValue === 'All' }}::boolean
    OR item_category_mat = ANY(
      string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.lotTypeCategories() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
    )
  )
  AND (
    {{ inpLotStatus.selectedOptionValue === 'All' }}::boolean
    OR status = ANY(
      string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.statusSet() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
    )
  )
  AND (
    {{ !(chkSterilized.isChecked || chkPasteurized.isChecked) }}::boolean
    OR (
      LOWER(COALESCE(process_type_mat::text,'')) = ANY(
        string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.processTypeSet() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
      )
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(process_type_mat_from_substrate_inputs::text,'')) = ANY(
        string_to_array(NULLIF('{{ (LotsPage.processTypeSet() || []).join(",") }}'::text, ''), ',')
      )
    )
  )
  AND (
    {{ !(inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All') }}::boolean
    OR strain_species_strain_mat = '{{ inpStrains.selectedOptionValue || "" }}'::text
  )
  AND (
    '{{ LotsPage.regulatedMode() || "all" }}'::text = 'all'
    OR (
      '{{ LotsPage.regulatedMode() || "all" }}'::text = 'regulated'
      AND TRUE = ANY(COALESCE(regulated_from_strain_id, ARRAY[FALSE]::boolean[]))
    )
    OR (
      '{{ LotsPage.regulatedMode() || "all" }}'::text = 'unregulated'
      AND NOT (TRUE = ANY(COALESCE(regulated_from_strain_id, ARRAY[FALSE]::boolean[])))

WITH lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,

    i.default_unit_size_g  AS item_default_unit_size_g,
    i.default_unit_size_oz AS item_default_unit_size_oz,
    i.default_unit_size_lb AS item_default_unit_size_lb,

    CASE
      WHEN l.harvest_weight_g IS NOT NULL AND l.harvest_weight_g::numeric > 0
        THEN l.harvest_weight_g::numeric
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.item_category_mat), ''), NULLIF(btrim(i.category), ''), ''))
           IN ('all_in_one_bag', 'casing', 'fruiting_block', 'grain', 'substrate')
           AND l.unit_size IS NOT NULL
           AND l.unit_size::numeric > 0
        THEN round((l.unit_size::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_g IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_g::numeric > 0
        THEN i.default_unit_size_g::numeric
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_oz IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric * 28.349523125)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS packageable_weight_g

  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON (
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
          THEN l.item_id::bigint
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) = i.nocopk
    OR (
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') <> ''
      AND i.item_id = l.item_id::text
    )
)

WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.nocopk,
    l.lot_id,
    l.item_name_mat,
    l.item_category_mat,
    l.strain_id,
    l.strain_species_strain_mat,
    l.regulated_from_strain_id,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated,

    l.vendor_name_mat,
    l.status,
    l.qty,
    l.unit_size,
    l.created_at,
    l.inoculated_at,
    loc.name AS storage_location
  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = l.location_id
  WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'grain'
    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(l.strain_species_strain_mat, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'colonizing',
      'colonized',
      'fullycolonized',
      'fridge',
      'colonizedfridge'
    )
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (
      'retired',
      'consumed',
      'compost',
      'composted',
      'expired',
      'deleted',
      'spoiled'
    )
)

SELECT
  lr.nocopk,
  lr.lot_id,
  lr.item_name_mat,
  lr.item_category_mat,
  lr.strain_id,
  lr.strain_species_strain_mat,
  lr.regulated_from_strain_id,
  lr.vendor_name_mat,
  lr.status,
  lr.qty,
  lr.unit_size,
  lr.created_at,
  lr.inoculated_at,
  lr.storage_location
FROM lot_rows lr
CROSS JOIN ui
WHERE (
    ui.selected_strain = 'All'
    OR ui.selected_strain = ''
    OR lr.strain_species_strain_mat = ui.selected_strain
  )
  AND (
    ui.regulated_mode = 'all'
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'regulated' AND lr.is_regulated = TRUE)
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'unregulated' AND lr.is_regulated = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(lr.inoculated_at, lr.created_at, now()) DESC,
  lr.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 500;

WITH events_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    e.lot_id,
    e.type,
    e.event_time_for_rollup AS t,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(e.fields_json::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS fj,
    l.strain_species_strain_mat AS species,
    l.item_name_mat_from_grain_inputs AS grain_txt,
    l.item_name_mat_from_substrate_inputs AS substrate_inputs_txt
  FROM public.vc_events e
  LEFT JOIN public.vc_lots l ON l.nocopk = e.lot_id
),
per_lot AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id,
    date_trunc('month', MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Inoculated')) AS inoc_month,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Contaminated') AS contam_at
  FROM events_normalized
  GROUP BY lot_id
)
SELECT
  inoc_month AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS inoculated_lots,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contam_at IS NOT NULL) AS contaminated_lots,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contam_at IS NOT NULL))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*)::numeric, 0),
    4
  ) AS contamination_rate
FROM per_lot
WHERE inoc_month IS NOT NULL
  AND inoc_month >= COALESCE(NULLIF({{ dpStart.selectedDate || "" }}::text, '')::timestamp, now() - interval '365 days')
  AND inoc_month <  COALESCE(NULLIF({{ dpEnd.selectedDate || "" }}::text, '')::timestamp, now() + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY inoc_month
ORDER BY inoc_month;

WITH events_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    e.lot_id,

  FROM public.vc_events e

),

    lot_id,
    MAX(species) AS species,
    MAX(substrate_inputs_txt) AS substrate_inputs_txt,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'Inoculated') AS inoc_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type = 'FullyColonized') AS col_at,
    MIN(t) FILTER (WHERE type IN ('FruitingStart','StartFruiting','StartedFruiting')) AS fruit_at,

  FROM events_normalized

)

  lot_id,
  species,
  substrate_inputs_txt,
  inoc_at,
  col_at,
  fruit_at,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (col_at - inoc_at)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 2) AS colonization_days,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fruit_at - COALESCE(col_at, bulk_at))) / 86400.0)::numeric, 2) AS time_to_fruit_days

SELECT
  p.nocopk,
  p.product_id,
  p.item_id,
  i.item_id AS item_id_text,
  COALESCE(i.name, p.name_mat) AS name,
  p.item_category_mat,
  p.net_weight_g,
  p.net_weight_oz,
  p.net_volume_ml,
  p.pack_date,
  p.use_by,
  p.storage_location_id,
  l.name AS storage_location,
  p.strain_id,
  s.species_strain,
  p.tray_state,
  p.harvest_flush_no,
  p.harvest_weight_g,
  p.harvested_at,
  p.origin_lot_ids_json,
  p.notes
FROM public.products p
LEFT JOIN public.items i ON i.nocopk = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN public.locations l ON l.nocopk = p.storage_location_id
LEFT JOIN public.strains s ON s.nocopk = p.strain_id
WHERE
  (
    NULLIF({{ selProductsCategory.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
    OR p.item_category_mat = {{ selProductsCategory.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text
  )
  AND (
    NULLIF({{ selProductsLocation.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
    OR p.storage_location_id = NULLIF({{ selProductsLocation.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '')::bigint
  )
  AND (
    NULLIF({{ selProductsStrain.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
    OR p.strain_id = NULLIF({{ selProductsStrain.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '')::bigint
  )
  AND (
    {{ !chkActiveProducts.isChecked }}::boolean
    OR (
      NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM regexp_split_to_table(
          lower(COALESCE(p.tray_state::text, '')),
          '[,;|]+'
        ) AS ts(state)
        WHERE regexp_replace(trim(ts.state), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
          'emptytray',
          'compost',
          'composted',
          'spoiled',
          'retired',
          'expired',
          'consumed',
          'shipped'
        )
      )
      AND regexp_replace(
        lower(COALESCE(l.name::text, '')),
        '[^a-z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) NOT IN (
        'compost',
        'expired',
        'shipped'
      )
    )
  )
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.pack_date::timestamp, p.nc_created_at, now()) DESC, p.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 500;

  p.notes
FROM public.products p
LEFT JOIN public.items i ON i.nocopk = p.item_id

WHERE
  (
    NULLIF({{ selProductsCategory.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
    OR p.item_category_mat = {{ selProductsCategory.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text
  )
  AND (
    NULLIF({{ selProductsLocation.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
    OR p.storage_location_id = NULLIF({{ selProductsLocation.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '')::bigint
  )
  AND (
    NULLIF({{ selProductsStrain.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
    OR p.strain_id = NULLIF({{ selProductsStrain.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '')::bigint
  )
  AND (
    {{ !chkActiveProducts.isChecked }}::boolean
    OR (
      NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM regexp_split_to_table(
          lower(COALESCE(p.tray_state::text, '')),
          '[,;|]+'
        ) AS ts(state)
        WHERE regexp_replace(trim(ts.state), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
          'emptytray',
          'compost',
          'composted',
          'spoiled',
          'retired',
          'expired',
          'consumed',
          'shipped'
        )
      )
      AND regexp_replace(
        lower(COALESCE(l.name::text, '')),
        '[^a-z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) NOT IN (
        'compost',
        'expired',
        'shipped'
      )
    )
  )
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.pack_date::timestamp, p.nc_created_at, now()) DESC, p.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 500;

WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.nocopk,
    l.lot_id,
    l.item_name_mat,
    l.item_category_mat,
    l.strain_id,
    l.strain_species_strain_mat,
    l.regulated_from_strain_id,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated,

    l.vendor_name_mat,
    l.status,
    l.qty,

WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsHarvest.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsHarvest.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated
  FROM public.vc_lots l
  WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'fruitingblock',
      'cordycepssubstrate',
      'allinonebag'
    )
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'fruiting',
      'colonizing',
      'spawned',
      'fullycolonized'
    )
)

SELECT
  lr.*
FROM lot_rows lr
CROSS JOIN ui
WHERE (
    ui.selected_strain = 'All'
    OR ui.selected_strain = ''
    OR lr.strain_species_strain_mat = ui.selected_strain
  )
  AND (
    ui.regulated_mode = 'all'
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'regulated' AND lr.is_regulated = TRUE)
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'unregulated' AND lr.is_regulated = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(lr.spawned_at, lr.inoculated_at, lr.created_at, now()) DESC,
  lr.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.item_id,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  i.default_unit_size,
  i.default_unit_size_ml,
  COALESCE(i.active, true) AS active,
  trim(
    concat_ws(
      ' ',
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN i.default_unit_size_ml IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size_ml::text || ' ml)'
        WHEN i.default_unit_size IS NOT NULL THEN '(' || i.default_unit_size::text || ')'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(i.item_id, '') IS NOT NULL THEN '— ' || i.item_id
        ELSE NULL
      END
    )
  ) AS label
FROM public.items i
WHERE COALESCE(i.active, true)
  AND (
    lower(COALESCE(i.category, '')) IN ('lc_syringe', 'syringe', 'lc-syringe')
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.category, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.name, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(i.item_id, '')) LIKE '%syringe%'
  )
ORDER BY
  lower(COALESCE(i.name, '')),
  i.default_unit_size_ml NULLS LAST,
  i.nocopk;
